[[Spasmo Thunderbolt]] is a [[Gargoyle]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Diessa Lowlands]] and [[Pockmark Flats]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ascalon]]
** {{NPC location|Diessa Lowlands}}
** {{NPC location|Pockmark Flats}} (atop the eastern path out of the flattened northern area with the large crystal)

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Whirlwind}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Granite Slab]]
* [[Scale]]
* [[Singed Gargoyle Skull]]

== Notes ==
* This boss shares two [[spawn]] points in Diessa Lowlands with [[Ignis Phanaura]] and [[Rif Telourau]], so one of the three will not spawn.
{{bug| Unlike other bosses in Prophecies, Spasmo Thunderbolt does not have [[Natural Resistance]].}}
